name: tp-ep-e2e-v3

note: Both arms must match on every field below before any comparison. Values are the repo defaults; override only in both arms together and record the override. divergence_policy: Identical greedy text is labeled text_exact, which is text equality, not runtime bit-exactness. Any divergent request yields text_divergent_needs_review and is NOT qualified until it has its own review entry. Kernel numerics evidence is component-level context and can never qualify the end-to-end result by itself.

reviews.evidence: path or note specific to this output

review_requirement: every divergent request needs one matching review entry with an allowed kind, passed true and non-empty evidence; otherwise the gate stays text_divergent_needs_review

kernel_oracle_context.note: component-level context only; it cannot excuse arbitrary text divergence

why_divergence_is_legitimate: TP4EP1 sums four 576-wide rank shards of one group; TP2EP2 has each route computed by one TP2 group, so the ordered FP32 sum order and the per-rank FP8 intermediate quantization granularity differ. Cross-topology output is never bit-exact (python/tests/test_v41_sentinel_masking.py).

six_rank: rhea (global rank 4) and moa (global rank 5) are connected but reserved for a full six-Spark set only (never independent builds, microbenchmarks, spare capacity or baseline replacement); no images or official checkpoint are present on them yet, and TP3EP2/TP2EP3 remain unqualified. Out of scope for this four-Spark corpus; a future full-six qualification needs its own corpus, provisioned images/checkpoint and matched metadata (docs/cluster-hosts.md).
build_root: Never build or stage under /mnt/scratch (read-only NTFS driver bug). Use a unique /home/tj/.cache/ds41rt/builds/<task> path on raptor root NVMe and run python3 scripts/assert-build-filesystem.py PATH... before direct builds.
